name: threejs-devtools-mcp

tools.name: scene_tree
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Scene hierarchy. Compact text tree by default (~2KB); compact=false for full JSON with positions/geometry.

types.description: Filter by type: Mesh, Light, Group, etc.

maxChildren.description: Max children per node (default: 15 compact, 100 JSON)

tools.name: object_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Detailed info about one object by name, uuid, or dot path.

tools.name: find_objects
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Search objects by type, material, visibility, name pattern, or custom property.

type.description: Object type: Mesh, Group, InstancedMesh, Light, etc.

value.description: Expected value of the custom property

tools.name: raycast
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Cast a ray from the camera through screen coordinates and return hit objects.

tools.name: click_inspect
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Click-to-inspect: the cursor becomes a crosshair — tell the user to click an object in the 3D view. Returns that object.

tools.name: scene_diff
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Compare scene state over time: first call saves a snapshot, next call lists added/removed/modified objects.

action.description: snapshot=save, diff=compare with saved, auto=snapshot if none else diff (default)

tools.name: layer_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Camera layer mask and objects with non-default layers.

tools.name: set_object_transform
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Set position, rotation, scale, or visibility of an object.

tools.name: set_layers
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Set layers on an object or the camera.

tools.name: material_list
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
All materials in the scene with type, color, transparency.

tools.name: material_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Full material properties: colors, PBR/physical params, maps, uniforms, defines, NodeMaterial (TSL) slots.

tools.name: shader_list
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Compiled shader programs with their materials (WebGL).

tools.name: shader_source
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Vertex/fragment GLSL source and uniforms of a material. NodeMaterial (TSL) has no GLSL — use material_details.

tools.name: texture_list
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
All textures: size, format, wrap, filter settings.

tools.name: texture_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Detailed info about one texture.

tools.name: texture_preview
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Show a texture as a PNG image. Use texture_list to find names/UUIDs.

tools.name: set_material_property
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Set a material property. Accepts the material name or the name of a mesh that uses it.

name.description: Material name, or name of a mesh using it

property.description: color, emissive, emissiveIntensity, roughness, metalness, opacity, transparent, wireframe, visible, side, depthWrite, depthTest, alphaTest, flatShading, fog, envMapIntensity; physical: clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, transmission, thickness, ior, sheen, sheenColor, sheenRoughness, iridescence, anisotropy, dispersion, specularIntensity, specularColor, attenuationColor

value.description: Hex string for colors ("#ff0000"), number for scalars, boolean for flags

tools.name: set_uniform
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Set a ShaderMaterial uniform.

value.description: Hex string for Color, {x,y,z} for vectors, number/boolean for scalars

tools.name: set_texture
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change texture sampling and transform: wrap, filter, anisotropy, repeat, offset, rotation, colorSpace.

tools.name: shadow_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Shadow maps: global settings, per-light bias/mapSize/camera frustum, casters and receivers.

tools.name: scene_background
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Scene background, environment map (IBL), backgroundBlurriness/Intensity, color management.

tools.name: env_map_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Environment maps: scene.environment, scene.background, per-material envMap.

tools.name: fog_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Scene fog: type (Fog/FogExp2), color, near/far or density.

tools.name: set_light
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change a light: color, intensity, position, castShadow, groundColor (HemisphereLight).

tools.name: set_shadow
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change shadow casting/receiving on any object, and bias/mapSize/shadow camera on lights.

tools.name: set_fog
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change scene fog (color, near/far or density) and the background color.

tools.name: camera_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Active camera: type, position, FOV, near/far, aspect.

tools.name: renderer_info
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Renderer stats and backend (WebGL / WebGPU): draw calls, triangles, memory, capabilities.

tools.name: renderer_settings
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Renderer configuration: toneMapping, exposure, colorSpace, shadowMap, pixelRatio.

tools.name: clipping_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Clipping planes: renderer global, per-material, ClippingGroup objects.

tools.name: postprocessing_list
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
EffectComposer passes: render passes, shader passes, effects (bloom, SSAO, …).

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change the active camera: position, rotation, FOV, near/far, zoom, ortho bounds.

tools.name: set_renderer
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change renderer settings: tone mapping, exposure, color space, pixel ratio, shadows.

tools.name: set_clipping
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change clipping planes on the renderer (global) or a material.

tools.name: set_postprocessing
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Enable/disable passes, set pass uniforms or effect parameters. Without a pass, lists passes.

tools.name: geometry_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Geometry of a mesh: vertices, attributes, index, bounding box, morph attributes.

tools.name: instanced_mesh_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
InstancedMesh: count, capacity, sample transforms, instance colors and custom attributes.

tools.name: batched_mesh_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
BatchedMesh: geometry counts, draw ranges, instance visibility. Lists all if no name/uuid.

tools.name: morph_targets
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Meshes with morph targets: target names and current influences.

tools.name: skeleton_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Skeletons and bones of SkinnedMesh objects.

tools.name: animation_details
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
AnimationMixers with their actions, clips, weights and playback state.

tools.name: set_instanced_mesh
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Change InstancedMesh count, visibility, frustumCulled.

tools.name: set_morph_target
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Set a morph target influence.

tools.name: set_animation
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Control playback: mixer timeScale/time, action play/stop/pause/weight by clip name.

time.description: Seek mixer time (not recorded as a change)

tools.name: web_audit
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Website health check: pixel ratio, canvas resize, idle/off-screen rendering, antialias cost, oversized or uncompressed textures, shadow cost, color space, draw calls. Each finding has a concrete fix.

tools.name: performance_snapshot
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Draw calls, triangles, instanced meshes, object counts by type.

tools.name: perf_monitor
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Record FPS and frame times for N seconds: avg/min/max, percentiles, spikes, jank.

tools.name: draw_call_breakdown
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Per-object draw call and triangle cost, sorted by cost. Flags multi-material objects and hidden geometry.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
GPU memory: geometry buffers, texture VRAM, instance data, top textures by size.

tools.name: dispose_check
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Leak detection: geometries/textures tracked by the renderer but no longer in the scene.

tools.name: console_capture
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Recent browser console output (log/warn/error).

tools.name: toggle_overlay
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
In-browser inspector panel: live FPS, draw calls, scene tree, materials, lights. Clicking a tree item highlights it.

tools.name: overlay_selected
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Everything about the object the user selected in the overlay: materials, geometry, transforms, textures, uniforms, shadows.

tools.name: highlight_object
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Highlight an object with wireframe, or toggle its visibility, to point it out.

tools.name: toggle_wireframe
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Wireframe on all materials or one object.

tools.name: bounding_boxes
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Show/hide bounding boxes — debug frustum culling and object bounds.

name.description: Target object (omit for all meshes) name

uuid.description: Target object (omit for all meshes) UUID

tools.name: add_helper
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Add a debug helper to an object: box, axes, skeleton, arrow, grid, camera frustum, light helpers, plane.

tools.name: remove_helper
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Remove a helper added with add_helper.

tools.name: run_js
tools.description:
[DEBUG VISUAL] Temporary visual aid in the browser. Nothing to put in code.
Run JavaScript in the page with scene, renderer, camera, gl in scope; `return` a value to get it back. Changes made here are NOT recorded in pending_changes — prefer the set_* tools for anything the user may want to keep.

code.description: JavaScript body. Vars: scene, renderer, camera, gl

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Screenshot of the current scene (also saved as PNG in screenshots/).

tools.name: annotated_screenshot
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Screenshot with object names drawn at their screen positions ([M]esh, [L]ight, [G]roup, [C]amera). Best for understanding layout.

tools.name: capture_frames
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Record a frame sequence for a video. Time is virtualised, so frames are exactly 1/fps apart and smooth even if rendering is slow. Saves numbered images to screenshots/sequence-<time>/ and returns an ffmpeg command.

tools.name: scene_export
tools.description:
[INSPECT] Read-only.
Export the scene or one object as GLB/glTF into screenshots/. Needs GLTFExporter in the app (the error explains setup).

tools.name: pending_changes
tools.description:
[FOR CODE] Output is meant to be written into the project source files.
Everything changed with live-preview tools since the last clear: before → after per property, plus ready-to-paste code (vanilla Three.js and/or React Three Fiber) and where to find each target. Use it to persist a preview into source; call again with clear=true once the code is updated.

clear.description: Forget the listed changes (after writing them to code)

tools.name: revert_changes
tools.description:
[LIVE PREVIEW] Changes the scene in the browser only — NOT saved to source code, lost on reload. Recorded in pending_changes (→ code edits) and undoable with revert_changes.
Undo live-preview changes in the browser (all, or selected ids from pending_changes), newest first.

tools.name: gltf_to_r3f
tools.description:
[FOR CODE] Output is meant to be written into the project source files.
Convert a GLB/glTF file into a React Three Fiber component (like gltfjsx).

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the .glb/.gltf file

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description:
[CONNECTION] Configures the devtools server.
Bridge connection, proxy target, and how to attach Playwright to the same browser.

tools.name: set_dev_port
tools.description:
[CONNECTION] Configures the devtools server.
Point the proxy at another local dev server port.

tools.name: set_dev_url
tools.description:
[CONNECTION] Configures the devtools server.
Inspect a remote Three.js app by URL. Source code changes are not possible in remote mode.

instructions:
Three.js devtools: inspect and tweak a live Three.js / React Three Fiber scene in the browser.

Every tool is labelled with one mode:
- [INSPECT] read-only.
- [LIVE PREVIEW] changes the scene in the browser only. Not saved to source code, lost on reload. Every change is recorded.
- [DEBUG VISUAL] temporary helpers (wireframe, boxes, overlay). Never goes into code.
- [FOR CODE] output to write into the project's source files.

Choosing between "show it now" and "change the code":
- User wants to SEE / TRY / COMPARE ("try red", "what if", "show me") → use LIVE PREVIEW tools, take a screenshot. Say clearly that nothing is saved yet.
- User wants it CHANGED / FIXED / KEPT ("make it red", "fix the shadows") → edit the source code. A live preview first is optional, to verify.
- After a preview the user likes ("keep it", "save") → pending_changes gives the before/after values and code; edit the source, then pending_changes clear=true.
- Unclear → ask once: "preview only, or change the code?"
- Remote apps (set_dev_url) have no source code: previews only.

Tips: start with scene_tree (compact) and targeted *_details tools; use web_audit for websites and capture_frames for videos.
